This template returns a link to the talk page of any given page.

This template can be substituted.

=== Usage ===
:{{tlx|Talk}} → This page's talk page: {{Talk}}
:{{tlx|Talk|File:Example.jpg}} → The given page's talk page: {{Talk|File:Example.jpg}}
:{{tlx|Talk|Foo|Bar}} → The given page's talk page, shown as a piped link: {{Talk|Foo|Bar}}
:{{tlx|Talk|2=2=Talk page}} → This page's talk page, shown as a piped link: {{Talk|2=Talk page}}
